scope: Stage 5 autonomous capture preflight decisions, scoped loop validation. Stage 5 remains incomplete.

limitations: Not a whole-workspace or whole-suite Miri claim.
Loom's generator/FFI model runs natively, not under Miri.
Long seeded loops and two-thread stress use explicitly smaller cfg(miri) counts; full counts run natively and applicable cases in Node/Chromium.
Browser/Web Audio/JavaScript and external C++ tracing are not interpreted; real-worklet and native tracing gates cover them separately.

miri_command: nix develop --command bash -c 'export RUSTUP_HOME="$HOME/.cache/rt-runtime-miri-rustup"; python3 scripts/run_rt_runtime_miri.py --package shoop_loop_engine'
audio: Existing scalar/ramp and dense one-sample comparisons now consume authoritative decision flags at every journal capacity; original fully provisioned cases retained. Complete workloads run unchanged in Miri/Wasm.

capture_decisions.workload: Complete workloads on native/Wasm/Miri: autonomous pulse suppression and unrelated request isolation; 128 one-sample intervals across three host partitions and journals 0/1/1024, with every external request slot occupied; restart refusal versus running exhaustion; both failure classes under one external slot; request-family priority independent of observation order; composite family versus target refusal and malformed target checks.

media_cases: Twenty-frame primitive table including same-state seek/replace, idempotent Play, retrigger, recording monitor continuity, monitored capture failure, stop and empty-content refusal; repeated previews.
Losing/cancelled/refused intents; retry discards prior candidate restart while retaining a later natural wrap.
Clock-reactive Stop masks an earlier start flag in the final decision; higher-priority reactive restart restores playback after pre-clock Stop.
Nested authoritative program snapshots emit only primitive flags even without a journal.

initial_failures.reason: Initial new test fixture used integer Entry.duration values instead of Option<u64>, producing E0308. Corrected to Some(2) without changing workload or assertions.

midi_cases.workload: Full native/Wasm/Miri workloads: independent absolute packet oracle and 257-byte SysEx; same-frame restoration ordering; stopped input and frozen initial state; invalid/stale/zero-frame calls; actual runtime overflow/reset graph preserving audio and clearing seeded downstream note; complete packet comparison across 128 one-sample intervals and three host partitions.

limitations: Twenty-four fresh selected loop Miri executions, not a fresh 138-case combined run or full loop-suite Miri claim.
The preceding runtime/host/full selected Miri evidence is historical; no rt_runtime implementation changed in this milestone.
Complete loop facade, coherent mixed-media outcomes/export, full example/graph and independent loop hosts remain pending.
